title: Launch checkpoint — personal docket
content:
Purpose: my scratchpad for the weekly launch checkpoint (internal 1:1 prep + notes I'll hand off). Keep raw — action items, follow-ups, and decision prompts.

Top priorities to surface
- Final canary run status (Arjun) — still seeing a TP99 spike at 320ms under burst traffic. Ask: is this persistent or correlated to a specific model version?
- DB migration window for rollout config store — confirm final schema roll-forward plan; backout plan if locks observed (Sofia owning).
- Secrets rotation: KMS key rollover scheduled 2026-03-18; confirm Private customers won't see auth failures.

Quick go/no-go checklist (my view)
- Core infra green: canary success >=3 runs (yes/no) -> ACTION: Arjun to post run logs by EOD 2026-03-12.
- Rollout scripts dry-run complete (yes/no) -> ACTION: me to run dry-run and attach output to RLZ-821.
- Smoke test coverage: streaming + batch + embeddings (pass/fail) -> ACTION: Sofia to validate embedding pipeline.
- On-call escalation rota updated (pass/fail) -> ACTION: Ping SRE rota owner.

Open questions / things to escalate in the sync
- If canary TP99 remains elevated, do we: pause rollout or reduce batch size & re-run? Need PM input on acceptable user-visible latency.
- Are we comfortable with the fallback model (quantized v2) quality regression risk? Add a short eval run against key prompts.

Personal prep notes for the meeting
- Pull latest smoke logs into /tmp/launch-checkpoint-logs and pdf snippets for quick share.
- Two-minute summary: 1) infra stable, 2) small latency anomaly, 3) migration pending.
- Ask PM for explicit SLO tolerance (numeric) to guide decision.

Action items (owner / due / status)
- Arjun Patel / 2026-03-12 / in_progress: Post canary raw logs + summary (link to heatmap).
- Maya Chen / 2026-03-12 / todo: Run rollout dry-run + stash artifacts in RLZ-821.
- Sofia Ramirez / 2026-03-13 / todo: Validate embedding pipeline smoke tests and confirm none regress.
- SRE oncall (TBD) / 2026-03-18 / todo: Confirm rota update and escalation runbook pinned.

Fallbacks and stop criteria (my draft)
- Stop if canary fails >1 critical smoke test or TP99 regression >25% vs baseline.
- Throttle rollout if transient spikes observed; auto-retry once after scaling down batch size.

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep the meeting tight — avoid deep infra debugging during go/no-go; capture threads and spin out follow-ups.
- If PM undecided on SLO, propose temporary guardrail: pause rollout and schedule a rapid A/B within 24h.
- Remember to capture decision rationale in RLZ-821 so we have audit trail.

End-of-day checklist before signoff:
- [ ] Canary logs posted
- [ ] Dry-run artifacts attached to RLZ-821
- [ ] PM confirms SLO tolerance or agrees to pause
- [ ] SRE confirms rota and post-rollout monitoring dashboard link

Last minute thought: schedule a 20-min post-rollout sync (ME/Arjun/Sofia/PM/SRE) for +1 day review and quality signoff.

-- Maya
